# Amazon Bedrock doc history — captured 2026-08-24
# Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/doc-history.html  (in sources.json, works)

## NO NEW ENTRIES since the 2026-08-23 capture. Newest is still AUGUST 19, 2026.
Newest entry: "Fixed Anthropic Messages API code samples and switched model-card OpenAI-SDK samples
to bedrock-runtime" (Aug 19) — reported 2026-08-21. Preceding dated entries: Aug 15 (x2), Aug 14, Aug 11.

## THE STANDING RULE — SELECT PARSERS AND AUTH BY ROUTE PATH, NOT HOSTNAME
BOTH Bedrock inference endpoints serve FOREIGN API SHAPES. AWS reversed its guidance on
2026-08-15/19 and now recommends `bedrock-runtime` for new applications INCLUDING OpenAI- and
Anthropic-compatible workloads (the direct opposite of the 2026-08-14 capture).
  https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/anthropic    <- Anthropic Messages API
  https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1    <- OpenAI Responses + Chat Completions
      (OPENAI_BASE_URL repointed on 49 non-Anthropic model cards away from the mantle /v1 route)
  https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/v1                  <- still fully supported
**Auth differs BY ROUTE, not just format**: short-term bearer token from
`aws-bedrock-token-generator` (`provide_token()`) on the documented `/anthropic` samples; SigV4 via
the `AnthropicBedrock` client on the Quickstart samples.
Model cards updated to the `/anthropic` + bearer-token pattern: Claude Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7,
Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, **Fable 5**.
`bedrock-mantle` remains the ONLY host for: **Web Search, Projects, Workspaces, Chat Completions on
mantle, and the mantle Responses API.** Neither endpoint can be dropped.

## COMPOUNDING FACT — WIDENED AGAIN 2026-08-24
`bedrock-runtime` serving the Anthropic Messages API intersects Anthropic's Compliance API blind spot
(Claude Code via Bedrock / Google Cloud / Microsoft Foundry is NOT captured). The routing path into
that gap now includes **BOTH official OpenAI SDKs** — Python v3.2.0 (Aug 17, reported 08-23) and
**Node v7.5.0 (Aug 17, read 08-24)** — not just Codex CLI 0.148.0. Arbitrary production applications
in either language can route there.
=> Coverage must come from the AWS ACCOUNT'S OWN LOGGING, not from either model vendor.
See openai_changelog.txt and anthropic_api.txt.

## Carried forward — reported 2026-08-21
- **Projects / Workspaces** — the mantle control-plane entity. Projects (OpenAI-compatible) and
  Workspaces (Anthropic-compatible) are THE SAME RESOURCE, managed by the Projects API at
  `POST|GET https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/v1/organization/projects`, returning
  `arn:aws:bedrock-mantle:...:project/proj_...`. They differ ONLY in the binding header:
  `OpenAI-Project: {id}` vs `anthropic-workspace: {id}`. IAM-addressable, tags, `status`, archive
  lifecycle. **Every account has a DEFAULT project that all inference lands in unless another is
  named** — default-attributed production traffic is a posture finding. Two traps: the project is
  asserted BY THE CALLER AT REQUEST TIME via header, so control-plane state alone won't tell you what
  traffic claimed; and a Bedrock Workspace is NOT an Anthropic workspace (`anthropic-workspace`
  carries an AWS `proj_` ID, not a `wrkspc_` ID).
- **AgentCore Memory integration for agentic retrieval (Aug 14)** — `memoryConfiguration` field on
  **`AgenticRetrieveStream`**; restore a session from short-term memory, retrieve from long-term, or
  both. Memory now CONDITIONS what a knowledge base returns.
- Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber and Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol added to Models at a glance. Both model
  IDs now also appear in the openai-node SDK v7.5.0.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no new entries.
